exam_scheme.note: The Management Aptitude Test (MAT) is a national-level entrance examination administered by the All India Management Association (AIMA) four times a year (February, May, September, and December) for admission to Master of Business Administration (MBA), Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM), and allied management programmes across 600+ participating business schools in India. Candidates can choose between Paper Based Test (PBT), Computer Based Test (CBT), or Remote Proctored Internet Based Test (IBT) modes. Under the revised examination structure, the test comprises 150 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each (total 150 marks) to be completed within 120 minutes (2 hours). The paper contains five sections: Language Comprehension (30 Qs), Intelligence & Critical Reasoning (30 Qs), Mathematical Skills (30 Qs), Data Analysis & Sufficiency (30 Qs), and Indian & Global Environment (30 Qs). Marking scheme: +1 for correct response, -0.25 for incorrect response. The composite score and percentile are computed using the first four sections (120 questions), while Indian & Global Environment is reported separately.
